name: KEMS
tagline: Live reality. Alpha6 what-if replay. One clear energy story.
summary: A focused local read-only companion for KEMS 0.7.0-alpha6, separating live, simulated, five-scenario what-if comparison and long-term performance data.
build: Alpha6 local focused dashboard · five-scenario Compare · multi-site Home Hub · optional built-in Home Assistant Container
principles: Home Assistant and KEMS remain the source of truth.
Home is always the centre of the energy-flow model.
Arrows follow the measured or simulated direction of energy.
Live, simulated and calculated allocation data are visibly labelled.
What-if scenario replay is read-only and never changes the active KEMS strategy.
KEMS native period summaries are authoritative for Week, Month, Year and All time.
The website remains read-only and cannot call Home Assistant services.
Raspberry Pi installs and updates can be sourced from signed GitHub releases without touching persistent KEMS data.
Raspberry Pi maintenance, updates and encrypted backups are managed locally from the KEMS Settings panel.
Each property keeps its own Home Assistant credentials and KEMS data on its own appliance.
A KEMS Pi can use an existing Home Assistant or optionally host Home Assistant Container locally.
Site identity and future remote hostname are local configuration and never shared between properties.
